recruiterCard.summary: Designed a multi-step research agent that synthesizes documents into sourced, structured predictions, then measures retrieval quality and output reliability.
impactBullets: Designed a multi-step research agent that synthesizes documents into sourced predictions in a fixed, parseable format.
Built an eval framework measuring retrieval precision and reasoning consistency over test suites.
Added guardrails, retry logic, and Pydantic schemas to enforce parseable, reliable structured outputs.
